_read_me: Copy this file to settings.json and edit it, or to settings_private.json
if it will hold anything you do not want committed. settings_private.json
is in .gitignore and is read first when both exist.
The two baud rates are null on purpose. Nobody has confirmed them on the
final wiring yet, and guessing a baud rate produces a link that looks
connected and delivers nothing but rubbish. Fill them in from the working
sketches, then write them down in
There is no saved_scaler_path. The StandardScaler is saved inside
classifier.joblib as the first step of the sklearn Pipeline, which is what
the previous repository did, so the scaler can never be applied by
accident or forgotten. saved_model_folder points at the folder that holds
the classifier, the feature schema and the reference embeddings together.
